## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wéimó jīng chāo* (T2773) is a one-fascicle anonymous Dunhuang manuscript in the *chāo* 抄 (excerpt / digest) genre. The *chāo* genre title indicates a digest of an existing commentary or a topical excerpt-collection rather than a continuous *shū* commentary.

**Abstract**

The *chāo* genre — extract or digest — was a common Tang teaching genre, producing usable summaries of longer commentaries for monastic study or for circulation among lay practitioners. T2773 is one of two such texts in the Dunhuang Vimalakīrti cluster (the other being T2774 = [KR6i0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0093)). The text likely digests one or more of the canonical commentaries ([僧肇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E8%82%87), [淨影慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E5%BD%B1%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0), [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F)) but the source is not explicitly identified.
